meta.prng: mulberry32; per-batch seed = FNV-1a(kind|seed|mode|policy or bucket)
meta.notes: Cards sampled uniformly over the turns in each bucket. effect frequencies use the first (only) effect: fx.<k> = share of all cards, fx_recruit/fx_enemy = share within that kind. Bot goalHitRate only in standard mode. meanHeartsT24 only in long mode.
meta.comparison: mean and sample (n-1) stddev across seeds; each seed value comes from gamesPerSeed games or generatedCardsPerBucketPerSeed cards. A port is compared by z = (mean_port - mean_v7) / sqrt((sd_v7^2 + sd_port^2) / seeds).
